title: Loss-aware transport geometry and bulk-tail ambiguity preregistration
research_question: Determine whether a transport geometry learned on training source families and training loss profiles improves realized decision regret on independently custodied shift families and held-out decision cost profiles without invalidating ambiguity calibration.

split_roles.purpose: Fit forecaster and loss-aware metric learner.
Select architecture, regularization, optimization settings and hyperparameters.
Compute frozen block nonconformity scores and radii after metric/model freeze.
Debug adapters, schema, arithmetic oracles and conformance only; never confirmatory.
Evaluate frozen artifacts on independent shift families and unseen loss profiles.

custody_protocol.family_id_policy: Use random opaque IDs with custodian-held mapping. Do not publish direct identifiers or unsalted hashes of low-entropy private IDs. Every transformed or augmented row inherits its source family's split.
manifest_commitment: opaque source-family references and family counts
canonical source-envelope SHA-256 digests and split Merkle roots
custodian role, signing-key fingerprint, detached signature and freeze timestamp
block size, horizon, source independence and canonicalization rules
custody_protocol.hidden_outcome_policy: Confirmatory outcome bytes remain custodian-only until model, metric, calibration artifact, evaluator and analysis-plan digests are frozen. Public repository stores commitments and authorized aggregates only.
freeze_record: forecaster source/model digest and parameter digest
metric family, parameters, unit scale and optimizer configuration
calibration score definition, alpha, fitted radius and calibration manifest commitment
policy-selection rule, cost profiles, evaluator digest and primary analysis plan
limits: A digest proves byte integrity after commitment, not source truth, completeness or independent sampling.
A signature identifies a signing key, not legal authority or truthful sampling.

candidate_methods.description: Expected loss under the forecast joint-state distribution.
NRES-012 TV policy where a binary event projection is predeclared.
NRES-013 exact finite-support fixed weighted-Hamming W1.
NRES-014 block split-conformal fixed-metric W1 radius.
Learn transport geometry on training families, tune on validation, calibrate only after freezing.
Separate high-mass bulk contamination from explicit bounded tail contribution.
CVaR/expected-shortfall policy objective as a separate risk comparator.
Infeasible statewise oracle lower bound; never a deployable method.

allowed_metric_families: Strictly-positive weighted Hamming with fixed diameter normalization.
Connected undirected graph shortest-path metric with strictly-positive edge costs.
metric_learning_protocol.normalization_rule: Normalize to a preregistered fixed support diameter; never tune radius units by rescaling the learned metric after calibration.
forbidden_leakage: No metric or alpha selection using calibration or confirmatory outcomes.
No checkpoint, cost profile or subgroup selection after hidden evaluation.
No repeated observation, radius, seed or service from one family counted as an independent family.

bulk_tail_protocol.bulk_definition: Freeze a high-mass bulk region using training/validation only.
bulk_tail_protocol.contamination_model: Declare bulk contamination fraction and which within-bulk perturbations are admissible.
bulk_tail_protocol.tail_bound_requirement: Predeclare support or tail-loss bound, tail mass estimator and uncertainty allowance separately from the bulk.
bulk_tail_protocol.unbounded_loss_rule: If arbitrary contamination can reach unbounded loss without a support/tail bound, report infinite or vacuous risk; do not silently clip.

calibration_protocol.block_dependence_rule: Cluster or mixing dependence inside a source family must be modelled; row-wise iid resampling is prohibited unless justified.
calibration_protocol.population_law_assumption: State conditional-iid, mixing or other sampling assumptions explicitly. Empirical-block coverage is not population-law coverage.
importance_weight_outputs: maximum/quantile importance weight and truncation policy
calibration_protocol.federated_privacy_rule: Score sketches and aggregation are not automatically differential privacy. Declare secure aggregation and/or a formal privacy budget, and report client-level and pooled coverage.

reporting_metrics: joint and marginal proper forecast scores
ambiguity score coverage and radius distribution
effective sample size and importance-weight concentration

confirmatory_targets.primary_estimand: paired relative reduction in mean realized statewise decision regret on independent confirmatory source families under predeclared shift families, comparing to the strongest frozen NRES-013/NRES-014 baseline.

guardrails: Protocol template and all NRES synthetic fixtures remain inactive in the curriculum.
No personal suitability, political belief, identity, loyalty, enlistment interest or natural-person fields.
No single composite resilience or robustness score.
No operational instruction, legal authority or institutional readiness certification.
A hash/signature does not prove truth or source independence.
All profile and shift results, failures and vacuity events must be reported.
